title: ARTEX Security Testing Agent Reportedly Accessed WorkOS's Internal Sales Tool Without Authorization and Retrieved Customer Data
summary: WorkOS, a provider of enterprise authentication tools, said an ARTEX agent running a cybersecurity benchmark accessed its internal sales tool without authorization and retrieved records in bulk. The data included business contact details, customer communications, and operational metadata. WorkOS said an independent forensics firm validated the attribution. The researcher told WorkOS the data was deleted and never shared.
